clips.what: Fire-pit fault: rider touches flame at in-game 16.95s, screen snaps to near-black in <0.1s, holds dark ~0.9s while bike is repositioned at checkpoint, then depth-of-field unblur/brighten ~0.45s; fault counter 2->3 flips to orange/yellow at end of fade-in; timer keeps counting through the whole thing (16.95->18.55). Red split delta jumps +0.554 -> +7.942 at the fade.

Two full ragdoll-fault cycles in 5.4s. Rider loops back off a steep ramp, falls backward, white impact flash at rider, HARD CUT (no fade) to green-lit checkpoint ~0.35s after flash, counter 4->5 flips orange. Rider re-attempts immediately, fails again ~2.4s later, counter 5->6. In-world checkpoint = green neon panel + green ground glow.
Rapid re-fault rhythm: three faults in 7s (5->6->7) on the same obstacle; shows how tight the attempt-fail-respawn loop is and the red circular direction sign that pulses on the right edge.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Test Your Might - All Extreme Tracks - 0 Fault Guide
clips.what: Evolution track start: loading screen fades into track, elastic squash-and-stretch "3", "2", "1" numerals at 1.0s intervals then "GO" (yellow outlined italic), camera swings from establishing angle to gameplay angle during countdown, tournament cumulative timer (04:00.248) already displayed.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Test Your Might - All Extreme Tracks - 0 Fault Guide
clips.what: Evolution finish: white light burst at the finish gate, timer freezes at 04:00.248, checkered-flag "FINISH!" ribbon slides up from bottom, then cut to tournament map with PROGRESS panel and loading screen.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution: Out of the Pit (Extreme) - No Faults & Platinum Medal
clips.what: Evolution personal-best finish: timer frozen at 01:00.190 with green -00:09.003 delta, "New Personal Record!" ribbon + platinum wings flourish, prompt row Results/Retry/View Replay, fade to RACE RESULTS: FAULTS: 0 TIME: 01:00.190, medal row with light burst on platinum, leaderboard neighbours, cash rewards ticking up.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution: Out of the Pit (Extreme) - No Faults & Platinum Medal
clips.what: Evolution menus: SELECT EVENT world-map with track thumbnails and medal states, SELECT RACE list with next-medal panel, leaderboard rows and button legend, fade to black before track load.

clips.source_title: TRIALS RISING Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FIRST 20 MINUTES (Exclusive Early Look)
clips.what: Trials Rising crash + instant full restart: nose-heavy landing, front wheel digs, rider pitches over bars (ragdoll), red "CRASH!" stamp scales in top-centre 0.2s after crash, player holds restart, HARD CUT to track start 0.75s after crash, HUD resets to 00:00.000 / 0 faults, ~1.4s idle, timer starts on first throttle and white italic "GO!" pops and drifts up-right.

clips.source_title: TRIALS RISING Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FIRST 20 MINUTES (Exclusive Early Look)
clips.what: Trials Rising track start: camera dollies from establishing shot into gameplay angle, "3","2","1" (white italic, drop shadow) at 1.0s spacing then "GO!", contract tag "FINISH UNDER 01:40" under the HUD pill, camera zooms out noticeably as speed rises after GO.

clips.source_title: TRIALS RISING Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FIRST 20 MINUTES (Exclusive Early Look)
clips.what: Trials Rising finish: rider crosses checkered line at 01:02.465, cut to cinematic front-facing crowd cam with camera flashes, teal "TRACK FINISHED!" tag slides in left of the frozen timer, green -00:07.500 delta, "TRACK REPLAYED +100/+25" reward panel top-right, tag swaps to "2ND PLACE" with opponent-avatar position bar ~1.2s later, ghost opponents keep arriving.

clips.source_title: TRIALS RISING Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FIRST 20 MINUTES (Exclusive Early Look)
clips.what: Trials Rising MEDAL EARNED / GOLD full-screen card on gold bokeh background, XP ring fills clockwise with +XP counters ticking, level badge, single "CONTINUE" prompt bottom-right.

clips.source_title: TRIALS RISING Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 - FIRST 20 MINUTES (Exclusive Early Look)
clips.what: Trials Rising tutorial-track finish: "TRACK FINISHED!" appears as the bike crosses the line, then the bike ploughs into a tyre stack, rider ragdolls, camera drops lower and pushes in on the wreck while the reward panel stays up (post-finish physics keeps running).

clips.source_title: Trials Rising: Ragdoll Bailouts & Crashes - Episode 2
clips.what: Trials Rising BAILOUT: rider ejects off the bike mid-jump, orange "BAILOUT!" stamp top-centre, camera detaches from bike and follows the flailing rider, HUD (timer/faults/progress) fades out completely once the body settles, camera dollies in and orbits slightly on the crumpled ragdoll, crowd NPCs react.

clips.source_title: Trials Rising: Ragdoll Bailouts & Crashes - Episode 2
clips.what: Trials Rising CRASH via explosive barrel: fireball, red "CRASH!" stamp, rider launched ~3 storeys high, 4s of free-fall ragdoll with limbs flailing, camera tracks the body not the bike, fog/atmospheric depth grading.

Trials Rising replay-mode HUD: red "REPLAY / MODE: DEFAULT CAMERA" tag top-centre, bottom control strip (fast forward / pause / restart, hide UI / change camera / quit), fault 0->1 shown as a hard cut with the in-game timer jumping ~11s (replay skips the crash dead time).
